name: SambaNova Cloud inference
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct list price on cloud.sambanova.ai, observed 2026-10-14 ($0.60 in / $1.20 out). gpt-oss-120b $0.22/$0.59; DeepSeek-V3.1 and V3.2 both $3.00/$4.50; MiniMax-M3 $0.60/$2.40 with $0.06 cached input; gemma-4-31B-it $0.38/$1.15. The same day OpenRouter flagged SambaNova Turbo at 25% off ($0.45/$0.90 effective) - a dated promotion, so the record holds the list price and notes the discount rather than recording the promo as the price.
notes: RDU-based (SN40L reconfigurable dataflow), the non-GPU high-throughput option in this set. Measured values are OpenRouter's 2026-10-14 P50 on SambaNova Turbo's llama-3.3-70b endpoint: 0.77s latency, 98 tok/s, 98.52% uptime - second-fastest on that table after Groq, roughly 4x DeepInfra-Turbo speed at ~6x DeepInfra-Turbo price. Catalog is small (6 models priced on the page) but covers the open-weight frontier. SambaNova also sells on-prem RDU systems; those are supply-type records.
